mp_definition: altered behavior of animals to approach and examine conspecifics
reclusive behavior; the tendency to refrain from participating in social situations and to seek isolation
decrease in the tendency for animals to approach and examine conspecifics
an inability, decreased ability or altered ability to produce sound from the vocal organs; or a general increase or decrease in the production of vocal sound
pilot_note: vocalization routes to A1 not A2 (A2 construct floor)

mp_definition: any anomaly in the ability of an individual to recognize another individual of the same species during repeated encounters
reduction in the ability of an individual to recognize another individual of the same species during repeated encounters
increased amount of time spent cleaning and/or keeping outward appearance tidy (self, mate or offspring)
defects in the standard of behavior of cleaning and/or keeping outward appearance tidy (self, mate or offspring)
pilot_note: abnormal grooming behavior, review flag expected

mp_definition: abnormal capability to sense pain elicited by thermal stimulation
a lower than average point at which thermal pain sensation is first detectable
aberrant threshold or reflex response to variable stimuli, often auditory; usually measured by amplitude of whole body flinch
sudden and often acute manifestation of epileptic attack, sometimes convulsive
repetitive, cyclical movements of the body or a body part; usually involuntary, but can also manifest in response to an attempt at movement
any structural anomaly of either of the two excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine
